About

Sales, campaigns and event operations

I am a BBA Marketing student at Islamic University, Bangladesh.

My work sits where sales, campaigns and event operations meet. I have sold on a marketplace, run promotions for a student business club, and organised a conference with delegates from 30 institutions.

I coordinate large teams, manage brand partnerships and run business events. In practice that means guiding volunteers, securing sponsors, tracking sales against a target, and getting a campaign in front of the right audience.

Model United Nations built my interest in international finance, trade and commerce, and the Sustainable Development Goals.
